WIFI.spot: Networks broadcast their name and lock type.
WIFI.protect: Use WPA2/WPA3. Skip open Wi-Fi or use a VPN.

BLUETOOTH.what: Short-range radio in earbuds, watches and tags.
BLUETOOTH.spot: Devices send adverts with a name and maker ID.
BLUETOOTH.protect: Turn it off when idle. Refuse surprise pairing.
